# falcon-v0.1.0 — boots and waves

The first tagged release of **falcon**, the dual-DNA flight stack
built inside [relay](https://github.com/pulseengine/relay).

This is a pre-product release: the binary boots, opens UDP sockets,
and exchanges MAVLink v2 heartbeats with a ground control station.
No flight dynamics yet. What it *does* ship is the verified
toolchain end-to-end — the WIT interfaces, the no_std/no_alloc
codec, the rivet evidence chain, and the CI gate that runs every
verification step as a reproducible command.

## What you get

- `falcon-hello` binary (vehicle + GCS modes) for x86_64 / aarch64
  Linux, x86_64 / aarch64 macOS, and x86_64 Windows.
- Cosign keyless signatures per archive (Fulcio OIDC, identity
  bound to `https://github.com/pulseengine/relay/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/falcon-v0.1.0`).
- SHA-256 checksums for every archive.

## Run the demo

```sh
# Terminal A — ground control station:
falcon-hello --mode gcs --duration 10

# Terminal B — vehicle:
falcon-hello --mode vehicle --duration 10 --rate 4
```

Or against QGroundControl on the conventional MAVLink port:

```sh
falcon-hello --mode vehicle --remote 127.0.0.1:14550
```

## Verification

The rivet evidence chain for v0.1 (`rivet list --type
unit-verification --filter '(has-tag "falcon")'`):

| artifact | steps |
|---|---|
| `FV-FALCON-MAVLINK-001` | `cargo test -p relay-mavlink`, release rerun, `PROPTEST_CASES=4096` fuzz |
| `FV-FALCON-EKF-STUB-001` | `cargo test -p relay-ekf-stub`, release rerun, `PROPTEST_CASES=4096` fuzz |
| `FV-FALCON-WORLD-001` | `cargo test -p falcon-hello`, `scripts/falcon-hello-demo.sh` |

CI gate on every PR posts the result as a sticky comment in the
`✅ Rivet verification gate — falcon` format.

```
✅ 3/3 passed
| count |   |
| Passed | 3 |
| Failed | 0 |
| Skipped (no steps) | 0 |
```

## What's not in v0.1 (honestly)

Per [falcon/README.md](https://github.com/pulseengine/relay/blob/main/falcon/README.md)
release plan:

- No Verus SMT proofs on new crates yet (v0.2 with the real EKF).
- No witness MC/DC coverage on the WASM (v0.2).
- No Gazebo SITL hookup (v0.3).
- No real flight dynamics (v0.3 hovers in SITL, v0.6 on hardware).
- No EASA U-space telemetry profile (v0.8).
- No six-domain credit dossier (v1.0).

Don't wait for v1.0 to get value. This release exists to prove the
toolchain works and to establish the cadence.

## Verify the cosign signatures

```sh
# Linux x86_64 example — works for all targets.
ARCHIVE="falcon-v0.1.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"

cosign verify-blob \
  --certificate "${ARCHIVE}.cosign.cert" \
  --signature   "${ARCHIVE}.cosign.sig" \
  --certificate-identity \
    "https://github.com/pulseengine/relay/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/falcon-v0.1.0" \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer \
    "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com" \
  "${ARCHIVE}"
```
